description: The file defines the TestConnection command class, which is used to test connectivity by establishing a Connection in a system based on the Eclipse Ditto framework. It includes methods for construction from JSON, obtaining the connection, and handling JSON serialization.

classes.name: TestConnection
classes.description: A final class representing a command to test a Connectivity instance by attempting to establish a Connection, with methods for creation, equality, hashing, and JSON serialization/deserialization.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new TestConnection instance from a Connection and headers, ensuring connection is not null.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Constructs a TestConnection object from a JSON string or JSON object along with headers, deserializing the connection information.

methods.name: getConnection
methods.description: Returns the Connection object associated with this command.
